item.description:
# LittleTidy 0.6.0
- More accurate reclaimable-space estimates based on allocated disk usage, with hard-linked files counted only once. - New AI storage categories for models, recreatable caches and logs, and reviewable sessions and generated artifacts. - Safer, clearer Developer Storage recommendations with selected cleanup candidates shown first. - Improved Overview and Cleanup Plan flows so each recommendation opens the correct cleanup mechanism. - Faster analysis through safe parallel processing of independent scanners. - Native JSON-based Xcode project format for more readable and merge-friendly project changes.

item.title: Version 0.5.0 (Build 7)
item.description:
LittleTidy 0.5.0

  • Native macOS UI Overhaul: Clean AppKit surfaces, removed marketing clutter and sparkle icons, virtualized file lists with 120fps scrolling.
  • Full Disk Access Detection: Real-time TCC probe with instant reactive status updates and deep link to Privacy & Security settings.
  • Sparkle Auto-Update: Built-in automatic updates with “Check for Updates” in Settings.
  • Notification Test Tool: Verify notification delivery directly from Settings.
  • Enhanced Cache & Storage Scanners: Added detection for modern AI agent caches (Ollama, MLX, Hugging Face, Claude Code, Cursor) and robust cancellation support.
